prompt:
Use case: game UI production asset, polished hand-painted fantasy card socket.
Create ONE original premium fantasy card-slot FRAME as a transparent PNG, inspired by the physical craftsmanship and restrained sculpted silhouette of Legends of Runeterra UI, not a copy of any existing frame. This is a deployable game UI asset, not a mockup sheet. Straight-on orthographic, symmetrical vertical rounded rectangular outline, outer aspect ratio 4:5. Fill nearly all canvas with frame, tiny transparent outer margin. The entire inner rectangular opening MUST be genuinely transparent, no portrait, no backing paper, no background. Interior opening roughly 86 percent of outer width and 86 percent of outer height, straight inner edges, lightly rounded corners. It will be displayed at only 152 by 190 pixels around an existing card.
Exactly THREE coherent material/assembly components:
1) A continuous deep midnight teal-black forged iron structural cradle around the whole perimeter, with believable restrained depth and broad quiet planes.
2) Sculpted warm antique bronze protective corner fittings that mechanically overlap and clasp this cradle, flowing into restrained tapered edge trim. Warm bronze surrounds DARK iron, not a gold top stripe. Four unified corner fittings are one repeated component, elegantly curved angular forms, a few strong facets, refined silhouette, no filigree clutter. Corners are slightly thicker than straight edges.
3) ONE small restrained violet amethyst rune clasp at bottom center, physically seated in the bronze cradle, roughly 13 percent of frame width, faceted but NOT glowing. No additional jewel elsewhere.
The material color difference BETWEEN dark iron, warm bronze, and violet stone is much stronger than the restrained shading variation WITHIN each component. Unified light from top left, cast/contact shadows at the joints, subtle worn edge sheen, actual painted metal grain. Elegant, cohesive, high-end game UI craftsmanship. Maintain a clear visual hierarchy, portrait remains dominant. No loose floating pieces, no separate disconnected colored side bars, no rainbow, no flat vector polygons, no thick bright outlines, no sci-fi panel, no spikes, no wings, no crown emblem, no letters, no text, no numbers, no resource counters, no separate title banner. Thin straight edges, modest corner emphasis. Transparent outside AND transparent inner opening.
edit_prompt: Edit this card socket frame for small in-game display. Preserve the exact artistic language, three materials (dark iron structural cradle, antique bronze sculpted corner fittings, one amethyst clasp), symmetry, orthographic view, and genuine transparent background and center. Make the entire frame MUCH SLIMMER: the transparent rectangular inner opening must be 86-88% of the outer width and 86-88% of the outer height; currently the corners and borders occupy too much space. Reduce corner ornaments and bottom jewel to about 65% their current size and metal rail thickness to about half. Keep sculpted overlapping joints, believable hand-painted metal textures and softly beveled volume. Make the bronze corner shapes compact and blunt, without protruding points. Outer aspect ratio remains 4:5; frame fills nearly the canvas. The frame will surround an existing 136x166 pixel card and must not hide that card's own colored outline. No text, no added symbols, no extra jewels, no disconnected bars, no flat painted stripes. This is the same frame refined into a thin polished game UI asset, not a redesign. Preserve alpha inside and outside.
